data.name: Never Stop Climbing
data.detailed_description:
Never Stop Climbing is a co-op precision platformer that can be played solo or with up to 8 players. Driven by the biological imperative of all Hamsters to climb everything in sight, you must ascend 8 uniquely themed and nostalgic stages inspired by the great classics. Collect power-ups and use teamwork abilities to overcome challenging obstacles in each stage.

Co-op:

Play solo or team up with up to 8 players. Will you race to be the first to reach each checkpoint? Or will you hang back and use teamwork to help your fellow hamsters? Unlock powerful new abilities as you climb to ensure everyone reaches Hamster Paradise!

Climb:

From the depths of the ocean to the edge of the cosmos, you must never stop climbing. Conquer 8 uniquely themed stages using power-ups and friendship. With branching paths throughout every level, a fall to the bottom just means finding a fresh route back up using your new power-ups! Hamsters get bored easily and need to find new ways to keep themselves entertained after all.

Choose Your Difficulty:

Climbing is great and all but sometimes a Hamster prefers to live a simple life. If you find climbing too difficult and want to enjoy the sweet life as a fuzzy little critter, checkpoints are your best friend. Make the climb as hard or easy as you want with our checkpoint system. If you fall and want to start all over again, you will be rewarded! If you fall and don't want to lose your progress, we got you covered! If you get stuck and want to skip ahead to where your hamster friends are, we still have you covered!

Hamster Shop, Power-ups, and Teamwork Abilities:

As you climb you will earn points. Spend points in the Hamster Shop to unlock new abilities like the front flip and co-op super jump. Feeling too toasty under the hot summer sun? Buy a water gun to spray your friends down! Feeling lonely? Buy a Hamster Pet to keep you company and emotionally support you if you fall! Customize your Hamster along the way with new skins and cosmetics earned through the Shop or by unlocking Achievements throughout the game.

data.short_description: Fulfill the biological imperative of a hamster with your friends in up to 8 player co-op. Parkour and climb through multiple uniquely themed and nostalgic levels inspired by classic platforming games. Ascend into space but watch your step! One wrong move and you'll plummet down to Earth!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600@ 3.1 GHz or AMD R5 1600X @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A high-speed internet connection and a good connection between players are required to play online
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400 3.1 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 2600x 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A high-speed internet connection and a good connection between players are required to play online

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur (Intel) / 13.0 Ventura (Apple Silicon)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU or Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon Pro 5300M
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A high-speed internet connection and a good connection between players are required to play online
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14.0 Sonoma or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 5500M
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: A high-speed internet connection and a good connection between players are required to play online
